messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xxs detected for inference-us-west-2 — error rate spike at 12:07 UTC, ~18% 5xx across gateway. Autoscaling triggered. Suspected: model-runner crashes (segfault/oom) triggering connection resets. See alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/alert/9876
oncall-ops: I'm on it. Paging oncall. Can someone grab runbook 'runtime-5xx-pager'? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: Looking at logs now, getting repeated lines: `model-runner[pid=4321] SIGSEGV @ 0x7f8c2a1b` then quick restart. Also a pattern of OOM before segfault in some nodes.
lee: Confirmed KV cache growth on a few nodes — kvcache size hits 32GB then OOM kill. Trace id 0a7b3c in logs.
samir: Stack snippet from crash dump: ```
#0 0x7f8c2a1b in attention_kernel::compute
#1 0x7f8c1f2d in kv_cache::append
#2 0x7f8c0a9f in runner::forward
```
infra-sre: Reassigning to eng-runtime and infra. Starting node isolations, cordon affected nodes to stop serving traffic. Rolling restart of model-runner daemon in progress.
eng-runtime: Aha — we recently rolled quant-attn kernel v2.2 to canary pool 3 hours ago. Reverting canary to v2.1 now. Can someone hold traffic to canary pools?
product-ops: Noting possible customer impact: increased tail latency and ~12% API failures for customers on dedicated capacity in us-west-2. CS notified.
oncall-ops: Executing traffic reweight: 100% -> fallback region us-east-1 for customers with multi-region routing. Applying policy now.
maria: Hotfix plan: 1) revert quant-attn kernel on canaries, 2) disable kvcache growth by enforcing per-request prefix trim, 3) scale up single-tenant fallback runners temporarily. Are we OK to push hotpatch?
lee: I'll push config to disable aggressive kvcache growth: `kvcache.max_entries=200000` and `kvcache.trim_interval=5s` — rolling to 10 nodes.
samir: Observed a node where GC didn't free pages causing fragmentation; adding `madvise(MADV_DONTNEED)` patch in runtime, will test locally then push canary.
eng-runtime: Pushing revert for quant-attn to canary (ID: deploy-2098765432-revert). Monitoring memory and segfaults.
infra-sre: Cordon/evacuate done for 6 affected hosts. New hosts added to maintain capacity, some requests still 502 -> gateway timeout during failover.
oncall-ops: PagerDuty: escalate to SEV-2 given customer impact and multiple regions affected (for some customers). CC @maria @samir.
product-ops: Preparing incident doc for external customers, ETA: 45m to triage and 2-4h for stabilization. Logging impacted customers and request IDs.
maria: Quick mitigation check: after revert to v2.1 on canaries, segfaults dropped to 2% in canary pool. Rolling revert to remaining pools with throttle.
lee: After config tweak, kvcache growth rate slowed, memory usage per runner reduced ~30% on test nodes.
samir: Deployed madvise patch to staging, looks stable. Will stage to prod canary after 5m smoke.
eng-runtime: Rolling revert now to 40% of traffic; will monitor error rates and latency. If stable for 10m, continue roll.
oncall-ops: Adding status note in #status-dashboard and pinging strategic customers.
product-ops: Customer-facing note drafted: "We are investigating elevated 5xx and timeouts in us-west-2 due to a runtime kernel regression; mitigations in progress." Ready to send on approval.
maria: Approve note, send now. Also collecting detailed traces for postmortem: please tag all related spans with `incident:2098765432`.
infra-sre: Observed one host with persistent 5xx after revert — we isolated it and collected core. Core indicates double-free in kv cache growth path. Saving cores to S3: s3://ops-cores/2098765432/
eng-runtime: Filed PR to add sanitizer on kv cache ops and additional guards. Tagging for next patch release.
lee: Current metrics: gateway 5xx down from 18% -> 4% in last 20m; request latency improved. Still monitoring for tail errors.
oncall-ops: Good work. Keep updates every 15m. If errors hold under 2% for 30m, we'll move to recovery and closure. :white_check_mark:
product-ops: Noting customers impacted: 3 enterprise accounts experienced degraded throughput, one reported timeouts on critical workflows. CS handling compensation talks.
maria: Postmortem owner assigned: @maria. Timeline: incident started 12:07 UTC, mitigation begun 12:12 UTC, partial stabilization by 12:40 UTC. Root cause hypothesis: quant-attn kernel v2.2 + unchecked KV cache growth -> memory corruption leading to segfaults. Next: full postmortem, test coverage for kvcache and kernel validation, safer rollbacks for kernel changes.
eng-runtime: Saving logs/traces and will open a GH issue with reproducer. Thanks team.
incident-bot: Incident 2098765432 state: investigators assigned, active mitigations, SEV-2. Follow runbook for collection and postmortem.
